# Security Policy
## Reporting a Vulnerability
This is a private/internal repository. If you discover a security vulnerability:
- **Do not** open a public issue or discuss it on any public channels.
- Immediately report the issue to your sub-team lead and/or manager.
- Include as much detail as possible (e.g., reproduction steps, logs, screenshots).
- The issue will be reviewed and triaged by the responsible internal team.
All reports will be handled confidentially and with priority.

## Disclosure Policy

Your report will be acknowledged promptly.
- If the issue is confirmed, a mitigation or fix will be implemented.
- Remediation plans and timelines will be communicated internally.
- Recognition or follow-up will be handled according to internal policies.

Thank you for your diligence in helping us maintain a secure internal environment.
